summary: Bukidnon 1st District representative with 107 principal-authored bills. Reviewed bills include abolishing the estate tax, raising the income-tax exemption and a worker income-augmentation measure. Facebook posts were district and religious-holiday updates.
caveat: Bill titles were truncated by the extraction and one (HB04866) is ambiguous; treat the economic score as provisional.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Principal author of estate-tax abolition (market-leaning) and a worker income-augmentation bill (redistributive), plus a higher income-tax exemption. Tax measures pull right, labor measure pulls left; net balanced. Automated bill extraction was messy.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB06568, HB10275, HB05297, HB04866 (retrieved 2026-11-01)
